request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Hexbloom Owl".

Creative brief
Name: Hexbloom Owl
Collection: Arcane Menagerie. Wild creatures altered by concentrated magic, with crystalline anatomy, runes, echoes, orbiting objects, and unusual projectile behavior.
Core concept: A hovering pattern caster that unfolds flower-shaped magical volleys.
Body and silhouette: Round owl with wide wings, short ear points, and a layered flower shape around its face.
Signature features: Petal facial disk, rune pupils, and square-tipped feathers.
Palette and materials: Deep indigo, dusty rose, pale cream, and luminous cyan.
Movement personality: Calm, watchful, and ritualistically precise.
Attack concept: Closes its wings, then opens them to release a six-petal arrangement of bolts that slowly expands and rotates.
Directional details: One petal above the left eye is dark and cracked.
Avoid: Cute scholar owl, realistic feathers, excessively intricate facial runes.
